Hero.title: hi, i’m joyce teodoro!
Hero.subtitle: Full‑stack developer since 2023, focused on building complete and innovative web solutions. Experience with Ruby on Rails, Hotwire, Node.js, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and various integrations such as Stripe, Clerk, and AI.

About.title: about
About.subtitle: About me
About.description1: I'm a fullstack developer since 2023. I'm a passionate about web development and I'm always looking for new challenges. <highlight>I combine technical skills with clear communication</highlight>, to create solutions that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing.
About.description2: My motivation is to contribute to the industry's growth, constantly striving to enhance the usability, accessibility, and performance of the applications I develop.

brazu.p1: At Brazu, I worked on professional development. I implemented customer registration APIs, integrated with payment platforms (Stripe and Guru), integrated Clerk for authentication, and built the plugins frontend integrated with the backend.
brazu.p2: This <video1>video</video1> shows the plugin I helped develop and this <video2>video</video2> shows the customers dashboard I developed.

valid.p1: At Valid, I worked as the front-end developer responsible for completely rewriting Carven, a platform that enables digital communication for vehicle sales between dealerships. The project was rebuilt using React, with React Query to optimize integration with the back end.
valid.p2: I was in charge of defining the front-end architecture (under the supervision of the tech lead), structuring the project from scratch, leading the componentization process, and ensuring code scalability. In addition, I prototyped new features in Figma and actively contributed to UX/UI decisions to enhance the user experience.

bompasseio.p1: Digital platform connecting local commerce and tourism, where purchases made at partner establishments generate accumulable points, later redeemable for guided tours.
bompasseio.p2: Includes management of businesses, tours, and points, an experiences showcase, redemption flow, and a user‑experience‑oriented interface. Technologies: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Hotwire, Tailwind, PostgreSQL, Render, Supabase. See the deploy.

dodo.p1: DODO is a task management web application that uses Artificial Intelligence to estimate task completion time, helping with daily planning and prioritization.
dodo.p2: Built with Ruby on Rails, Hotwire, and OpenAI, the app automates time estimates and centralizes task control in a single flow. Code on GitHub and live deploy.
